from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import json, hashlib

roots = [Path('/tmp/neospice-joss-corpus-run-31-ng47-full'), Path('/tmp/neospice-joss-corpus-run-32-ng47-full')]
plans = [json.loads((p/'run.json').read_text()) for p in roots]
assert all(p['complete'] and p['completed_fixtures']==67359 for p in plans)
assert plans[0]['fixtures']==plans[1]['fixtures']
pre = [json.loads((p/'preflight.json').read_text()) for p in roots]
assert pre[0]['inventory']['reference']['sha256']==pre[1]['inventory']['reference']['sha256']
assert pre[0]['inventory']['startup_and_codemodels']==pre[1]['inventory']['startup_and_codemodels']
counts = defaultdict(Counter)
changed = []
engine_changes = {'neospice':[], 'reference':[]}
for item in plans[0]['fixtures']:
    rel = Path('cases')/item['case_id']/item['variant']/'comparison.json'
    a,b = [json.loads((root/rel).read_text()) for root in roots]
    assert a['identity']==b['identity'] and a['materialized_fixture']['sha256']==b['materialized_fixture']['sha256']
    counts[item['variant']][a['status']+' -> '+b['status']] += 1
    identity = dict(case_id=item['case_id'],variant=item['variant'],identity=a['identity'])
    if a['status']!=b['status']:
        changed.append(dict(identity, before=a['status'], after=b['status']))
    for engine in engine_changes:
        fields = [k for k in ['ok','failure_class','returncode','values'] if a[engine][k]!=b[engine][k]]
        if fields:
            engine_changes[engine].append(dict(identity, differing_fields=fields,
                before_failure=a[engine]['failure_class'],after_failure=b[engine]['failure_class']))
report = dict(reference_version='47',roots=list(map(str,roots)),fixtures_reconciled=67359,
    input_manifest_sha256=plans[0]['input_manifest']['sha256'],fixture_bytes_identical=True,
    neospice_binaries=[p['inventory']['neospice'] for p in pre],
    transitions_by_variant={k:dict(v) for k,v in counts.items()},changed_outcomes=changed,
    engine_result_changes=engine_changes,
    limitations=['Different neospice candidates and separate executions; unchanged reference can still have timeout or floating-point runtime differences',
        'No outcome transition is attributed to a source correction without case-level analysis',
        'Frozen lexical identities do not prove independently bound model definitions; no full-model certification'],
    generation_script=Path(__file__).read_text())
out=Path('docs/evidence/joss/2026-09-11-checkpoint32-candidate47-transitions.json')
out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'outcome_changes':len(changed),'engine_result_changes':{k:len(v) for k,v in engine_changes.items()},
    'transitions':report['transitions_by_variant'],'path':str(out),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
